records.heading: Course overview and prerequisites
records.content: Naam: AI Product Photoshoot & Ads (Skillomate). Format: Hinglish, chhote video lessons, ek AI presenter. Lessons: 8. Example product: white 60% compact mechanical keyboard, red accent keys, price ₹2,599 (sirf example). Kiske liye: jo apna product online bechte hain, aur jo dusron ke liye product ads banana chahte hain. Zarurat: phone, laptop, koi bhi product.

records.heading: Lesson 01 — Course Intro
records.content: Course Intro Course mein kya banega, tools, kya chahiye

records.heading: Lesson 02 — Phone Photo Se Studio Photo
records.content: Phone Photo Se Studio Photo Angle photos → Product Sheet → white studio, lifestyle, dark premium

records.heading: Lesson 03 — Model Ke Saath Product
records.content: Model Ke Saath Product Character sheet + product sheet saath, 3 model shots, haathon ki galtiyan

records.heading: Lesson 04 — Festive Shoot + Colour Variants
records.content: Festive Shoot + Colour Variants Diwali, wedding gift scenes; har rang ki nayi product sheet

records.heading: Lesson 05 — chat G.P.T Se Ad Plan
records.content: chat G.P.T Se Ad Plan Buyers, problems, angles; hooks, script, caption; Flow prompts

records.heading: Lesson 06 — Photo Se Product Video
records.content: Photo Se Product Video Ingredients mode, ek movement: push-in, arc, light sweep

records.heading: Lesson 07 — UGC-Style Video
records.content: UGC-Style Video AI insaan phone-style video, 9:16; phone frame mein na aaye

records.heading: Lesson 08 — Finale
records.content: Finale Poora workflow, top galtiyan, imaandari, final project; prompts notes mein

records.heading: Product sheet banana
records.content: • Phone se product ki 5–7 photos, alag angles, din ki roshni, flash off, details saaf. • Google Flow → New project → Image → Nano Banana Pro. • Saari photos upload/reference mein lagao → product sheet prompt chalao. • Sheet achhi na aaye toh dobara generate karo. Achhi sheet ko save rakho — poore course mein yahi reference hai.

records.heading: Product photos
records.content: • Reference mein sirf product sheet. • Prompt ki pehli line: product bilkul waisa hi. • Phir scene: jagah, 2–3 cheezein, roshni, angle. Sajawat peeche, product aage.

records.heading: Model shots
records.content: • Character sheet + product sheet dono reference mein. • Model ke kapde/look prompt mein sheet se match karke likho. • "natural hands with five fingers" likho. 2–3 versions banao.

records.heading: Colour variants
records.content: • Reference: product sheet. • "Only change the colour of [part] to [colour]. Keep everything else exactly the same." • Har rang ki poori sheet banao, aage ke shots usi se.

records.heading: Ad plan
records.content: • Ek hi chat mein: details + price + kahan bechte ho → 3 buyers, problems, angles. • Angle chuno → 5 hooks + 15-sec script + caption, "use only the features I gave you". • Flow ke 3 image prompts likhwao → Flow mein product sheet ke saath chalao. • Output padh ke jhoothe/unproven claims hatao.

records.heading: Product video
records.content: • Flow → Video → Ingredients → photo daalo. • Course settings: 16:9, Omni 1.1 Flash, 720p, 6 sec, x1. • Ek movement: push-in / arc / light sweep. Music nahi — baad mein editing mein.

records.heading: UGC video
records.content: • Flow → Video → Ingredients: chehra + character sheet + product sheet. • Course settings: 9:16, 720p, 8 sec. • Prompt: camera hi phone hai, frame mein koi phone nahi; ghar ka kamra, studio nahi. • Dialogue chhota (Hindi, Devanagari mein likho), L05 ke hook se.

records.heading: Label ke akshar / keys ke letters
records.content: Label ke akshar / keys ke letters Product sheet reference lagao, pehli line "keep exactly the same, badal gaye same text and logo". Chhota text AI ki limitation hai — 2–3 versions banao, best chuno. (L02)

records.heading: Har photo mein product thoda alag
records.content: Har photo mein product thoda alag Sheet ke bina bana rahe ho. Pehle product sheet banao, phir har dikh raha photo usi se. (L02, L08)

records.heading: Product bahut chhota/bada dikh raha
records.content: Product bahut chhota/bada dikh raha Prompt mein "realistic real-world scale" add karo.

records.heading: Model ki ungliyan judi / extra
records.content: Model ki ungliyan judi / extra "natural hands with five fingers" + dobara generate. Haath AI ke liye mushkil hain. (L03)

records.heading: Model ke haath kisi aur ke lag rahe
records.content: Model ke haath kisi aur ke lag rahe Prompt mein kapde/details character sheet se alag likhe hain. Match karo. (L03)

records.heading: Model ka chehra badal gaya
records.content: Model ka chehra badal gaya Character sheet reference mein lagao aur "keep her face exactly the same as the character sheet" likho.

records.heading: Rang badla toh shape bhi badal gaya
records.content: Rang badla toh shape bhi badal gaya "Only change the colour... keep everything else exactly the same". (L04)

records.heading: Brand ka exact colour nahi aa raha
records.content: Brand ka exact colour nahi aa raha Exact shade hamesha nahi aata. 2–3 baar banao, sabse paas wala chuno. (L04)

records.heading: chat G.P.T ka ad bahut generic
records.content: chat G.P.T ka ad bahut generic Asli details, price, kahan bechte ho do; pehle buyers aur angles poocho. (L05)

records.heading: chat G.P.T ne aisa feature likha jo
records.content: chat G.P.T ne aisa feature likha jo Hata do. Prompt mein "use only the features I gave you" likho. (L05) product mein nahi

records.heading: Video mein product pighal/morph
records.content: Video mein product pighal/morph Ek hi dheema movement rakho, "stays perfectly still, no morphing". raha (L06)

records.heading: Video mein letters blur
records.content: Video mein letters blur Movement mein chhota text bigad sakta hai. Dheema movement, 2–3 baar banao. (L06)

records.heading: UGC video mein phone dikh raha
records.content: UGC video mein phone dikh raha "The camera itself is her phone. NO phone visible anywhere in the frame." (L07)

records.heading: UGC bahut polished/ad jaisa
records.content: UGC bahut polished/ad jaisa "normal home room, handheld look, not a studio, not a polished ad". (L07)

records.heading: Vertical clip landscape mein side
records.content: Vertical clip landscape mein side Clip 9:16 bana hai. Reels ke liye project 9:16 rakho; landscape chahiye mein blur toh Flow mein 16:9 select karke dobara banao.

records.heading: Kya AI model ko customer review
records.content: Kya AI model ko customer review Nahi. AI insaan asli grahak nahi hai — ise review/testimonial bata ke bata sakte hain? mat chalao. Product dikhane ke liye use karo. (L07)

records.heading: Final ad kaise edit karein?
records.content: Final ad kaise edit karein? Course mein CapCut tutorial nahi hai; final ad ka order: UGC hook → product videos → UGC → end card (price + order kaise karein). Text aur price editing mein daalo, AI se nahi.

records.heading: Prompts kahan milenge?
records.content: Prompts kahan milenge? Saare prompts notes section mein hain (L08).

records.heading: L02 Product Sheet
records.content: Use all the uploaded photos of this [PRODUCT]. Create a clean product reference sheet on a plain white background showing the exact same [PRODUCT] in four views arranged in a neat grid: front view, top-down view, side view and three-quarter angle view. Keep the [PRODUCT] exactly the same in every view — same shape, same colour, same details, same text and logo, do not redesign it. Even soft studio lighting, no extra objects, no text labels, realistic product photography.

records.heading: L02 White Studio
records.content: Use the uploaded product sheet as the reference. Keep the [PRODUCT] exactly the same — same shape, same colour, same details, same text and logo, do not redesign it. Place it on a clean seamless white background, soft even studio lighting, a soft natural shadow under it, slight top-down angle, sharp focus, realistic product photography.

records.heading: L02 Lifestyle
records.content: Use the uploaded product sheet as the reference. Keep the [PRODUCT] exactly the same — same shape, same colour, same details, same text and logo, do not redesign it. Place it on a warm wooden desk next to a white coffee mug and a small green plant, soft morning window light from the left, shallow depth of field, realistic lifestyle product photography.

records.heading: L02 Dark Premium
records.content: Use the uploaded product sheet as the reference. Keep the [PRODUCT] exactly the same — same shape, same colour, same details, same text and logo, do not redesign it. Place it on a matte black surface against a dark background, a single soft rim light outlining its edges, a subtle reflection on the surface, premium moody look, realistic product photography.

records.heading: L03 Character Sheet (bonus)
records.content: Create a character reference sheet of one realistic young Indian [man / woman], clearly adult, [hair, outfit details]. Show the exact same person in one image: a close-up of the face, and full-body front view, side view and back view on a plain light grey background. Same face, same hair, same outfit in every view. Soft even light, RAW realistic photo look, real skin texture, no text labels.

records.heading: L03 Hands close-up
records.content: Use the uploaded product sheet for the [PRODUCT] and the uploaded character sheet for the [woman / man]. Keep the [PRODUCT] exactly the same — same shape, same colour, same details, same text and logo, do not redesign it. Close-up of the [woman's] hands using the [PRODUCT] on a wooden desk, [clothing that matches the character sheet, e.g. bare arms matching her blue tank top], natural hands with five fingers each, soft window light, shallow depth of field, realistic real-world scale, realistic lifestyle product photography.

records.heading: L03 Desk
records.content: Use the uploaded product sheet for the [PRODUCT] and the uploaded character sheet for the [woman / man]. Keep the [PRODUCT] exactly the same — same shape, same colour, same details, same text and logo, do not redesign it. Keep the [woman's] face exactly the same as the character sheet. [She] sits at a clean desk using the [PRODUCT], side three-quarter angle, natural hands with five fingers, bright natural daylight, realistic real-world scale, realistic lifestyle photography.

records.heading: L03 Showing to camera
records.content: Use the uploaded product sheet for the [PRODUCT] and the uploaded character sheet for the [woman / man]. Keep the [PRODUCT] exactly the same — same shape, same colour, same details, same text and logo, do not redesign it. Keep the [woman's] face exactly the same as the character sheet. [She] holds the [PRODUCT] with both hands in front of [her] chest, showing it to the camera with a small natural smile, plain light background, soft studio light, natural hands with five fingers, realistic real-world scale, realistic product photography.

records.heading: L04 Diwali
records.content: Use the uploaded product sheet as the reference. Keep the [PRODUCT] exactly the same — same shape, same colour, same details, same text and logo, do not redesign it. Place it on a wooden table during Diwali night, a few lit clay diyas and orange marigold flowers placed behind and beside it, soft warm fairy lights glowing out of focus in the background, the [PRODUCT] sharp and clearly the hero in the foreground, warm golden light, realistic real-world scale, realistic festive product photography.

records.heading: L04 Wedding Gift
records.content: Use the uploaded product sheet as the reference. Keep the [PRODUCT] exactly the same — same shape, same colour, same details, same text and logo, do not redesign it. Place it on a soft silk cloth next to an open premium gift box with gold ribbon and a few rose petals, elegant wedding gifting mood, soft warm light, [PRODUCT] sharp in the foreground, realistic real-world scale, realistic festive product photography.

records.heading: L04 Colour Variant Sheet
records.content: Use the uploaded product sheet as the reference. Only change the colour of [the part, e.g. all the keycaps] to [new colour, e.g. soft pastel pink]. Keep everything else exactly the same — same shape, same layout, same details, same text and logo, same four views, same background, same lighting. Output a full product sheet in the new colour.

records.heading: L05 Step 1 Brief
records.content: I sell a [product with real details — size, colour, key features]. Price: [your price]. I sell on [Instagram / website / marketplace] in India. Tell me: 1. Three types of people who would buy this 2. What problem it solves for each of them 3. One ad angle for each buyer Keep it short and simple.

records.heading: L05 Step 2 Hooks + Script
records.content: Pick angle [number]. Write 5 scroll-stopping hooks in natural Hinglish, like a friend talking — not cheesy, no fake claims. Then write a 15-second ad script: what to show on screen and what the voiceover says. Also write one Instagram caption. Use only the features I gave you, don't add anything new.

records.heading: L05 Step 3 Flow prompts
records.content: Now write 3 image prompts for Google Flow (Nano Banana) for this ad. Each prompt must start with: "Use the uploaded product sheet as the reference. Keep the [product] exactly the same — same shape, same colour, same details, same text and logo, do not redesign it." Then describe one scene for the ad.

records.heading: L06 Push-in
records.content: Use the uploaded image as the first frame. The [PRODUCT] stays perfectly still and exactly the same the whole time — same shape, same colour, same details, same text and logo, no morphing, no warping. The camera slowly and smoothly pushes in toward the [PRODUCT]. Soft natural window light, shallow depth of field, realistic product video. No people, no hands, no text on screen. Soft quiet room ambience only — NO music, NO voice.

records.heading: L06 Arc
records.content: Use the uploaded image as the first frame. The [PRODUCT] stays perfectly still and exactly the same the whole time — same shape, same colour, same details, same text and logo, no morphing, no warping. The camera slowly arcs a little to the right around the [PRODUCT], smooth and steady, while the lights in the background glow softly. Moody cinematic look, realistic product video. No people, no hands, no text on screen. Soft quiet room ambience only — NO music, NO voice.

records.heading: L06 Light Sweep
records.content: Use the uploaded image as the first frame. The [PRODUCT] stays perfectly still and exactly the same the whole time — same shape, same colour, same details, same text and logo, no morphing, no warping. The camera stays completely still. A soft band of warm light slowly sweeps across the [PRODUCT] from left to right, the shadows moving gently with it. Clean premium product video. No people, no hands, no text on screen. Soft quiet room ambience only — NO music, NO voice.

records.heading: L07 UGC 1
records.content: Use the uploaded character sheet for the [woman] and the uploaded product sheet for the [PRODUCT]. Keep her face, hair and outfit exactly the same as the character sheet. Keep the [PRODUCT] exactly the same — same shape, same colour, same details, same text and logo, no morphing. Selfie-style vertical video: the camera itself is her phone, held at arm's length, so we see her from the chest up looking straight into the lens. NO phone visible anywhere in the frame, no second camera, no screen. She sits at a desk in a normal home room, holding the [PRODUCT] up near her chest to show it, casual and friendly. Handheld look with slight natural shake, natural window light, a real lived-in room, not a studio, not a polished ad. ONLY she speaks, one voice only, natural Hindi lip-sync, casual friendly tone. She says: "[your hook line in Hindi]" real skin, no filter, clearly adult, modest, natural hands with five fingers, no text on screen, no watermark. Clean natural audio only — NO background music.

records.heading: L07 UGC 2
records.content: Use the uploaded character sheet for the [woman] and the uploaded product sheet for the [PRODUCT]. Keep her face, hair and outfit exactly the same as the character sheet. Keep the [PRODUCT] exactly the same — same shape, same colour, same details, same text and logo, no morphing. Vertical video shot from her own phone resting on the desk in front of her: the camera itself is the phone, so we see her and the [PRODUCT] from a low front angle. NO phone visible anywhere in the frame, no second camera, no screen facing us. She uses the [PRODUCT] for a moment, then looks up straight into the lens and talks, casual and natural. Natural window light, a real lived-in room, not a studio, not a polished ad. ONLY she speaks, one voice only, natural Hindi lip-sync, casual friendly tone. She says: "[your second line in Hindi]" real skin, no filter, clearly adult, modest, natural hands with five fingers, no text on screen, no watermark. Clean natural audio only — NO background music.
